description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'SugarDateTimeTest' for the 'SugarDateTime' class, testing its date manipulation methods such as get_day_begin, get_day_end, asDb, asDbDate, get_date_str, and get_day_by_index_this_month.

classes.name: SugarDateTimeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the methods of SugarDateTime class.

methods.name: testget_day_begin
methods.description: Tests that get_day_begin returns a SugarDateTime object set to the start of the day (00:00:00).

methods.name: testget_day_end
methods.description: Tests that get_day_end returns a SugarDateTime object set to the end of the day (23:59:59).

methods.name: testasDb
methods.description: Tests that asDb returns the date formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' for database storage.

methods.name: testasDbDate
methods.description: Tests that asDbDate returns the date formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

methods.name: testget_date_str
methods.description: Tests that get_date_str returns a URL parameter string with year, month, day, and hour.

methods.name: testget_day_by_index_this_month
methods.description: Tests that get_day_by_index_this_month returns the correct SugarDateTime for a given day index within the month.

methods.name: testget_day_by_index_this_monthWithExcessiveValue
methods.description: Tests that get_day_by_index_this_month correctly handles indexes larger than the number of days in the month, returning subsequent months.
